mapper.select: SELECT OM.MODEL, OM.BUILD, GENERAL.PRODUCT_TYPE, GENERAL.VIN, KOLA.SYMBOL, GENERAL.COUNTRY_OF_OPERATION, VDA.FAMILY_ID, VDA.VARIANT_ID, OM.CUSTOMER_ADAP FROM HDOC_REC_DATA_VDA_GENERAL GENERAL INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_OM OM ON OM.SERIE = GENERAL.SERIE AND OM.CHNR = GENERAL.CHNR INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_VDA_VARIANTS VDA ON GENERAL.SERIE = VDA.SERIE AND GENERAL.CHNR = VDA.CHNR INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_KOLA_VARIANT KOLA ON VDA.FAMILY_ID = KOLA.FAMILY_ID AND VDA.VARIANT_ID = KOLA.VARIANT_ID WHERE GENERAL.SERIE = #{serie} AND GENERAL.CHNR = #{chno}

SELECT LPAD(SUBSTRING(KOLA.SYMBOL, 1, 8), 8, ' ') AS SYMBOL_STR, KOLA.FUNCTION_GROUP, KOLA.DESCRIPTION FROM HDOC_REC_DATA_KOLA_VARIANT KOLA WHERE KOLA.FAMILY_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{familyId}, '%') AND KOLA.VARIANT_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{variantId}, '%') ORDER BY CONCAT(LPAD(KOLA.FUNCTION_GROUP, 4, ' '), LPAD(KOLA.FAMILY_ID, 3, ' '))
